Class Orc

java.lang.Object
model.entity.base.CharacterModel
model.entity.base.Enemy
model.entity.concrete.Orc
public class Orc extends Enemy
Represents an Orc-type enemy.

Orcs are powerful and resilient creatures with strong attack values but low speed. This class extends Enemy and initializes an Orc with its predefined default statistics and specific CharacterType.
